name: MonarchAiReasoning
title: AiReasoning
wrapsNative: DisclosureGroup with .disclosureGroupStyle(.monarch); MonarchAiThinkingIndicator (TimelineView) as the live timer in the header
summary: The model's reasoning for one answer, as a disclosure that reads "Thinking…" with a live timer while it streams and "Thought for 12s" once it finishes.
whenToUse: Inside an assistant reply, to show a reasoning part (MonarchAiReasoningPart) from the message model without letting it crowd the answer.
whenNotToUse: Not for the wait before the first token when there is no reasoning to show (use MonarchAiThinkingIndicator) and not for the steps of an agent (use MonarchAiChainOfSteps).
api: init(_ part: MonarchAiReasoningPart, startedAt: Date? = nil, startsExpanded: Bool = false, labels: MonarchAiReasoningLabels = MonarchAiReasoningLabels(), onExpandedChange: (@MainActor (Bool) -> Void)? = nil)

struct MonarchAiReasoningLabels { init(prefix: String? = nil, thinking: String? = nil, thoughtFor: ((String) -> String)? = nil, thought: String? = nil, reasoningHidden: String? = nil, duration: ((Int) -> String)? = nil) }

options.name: part
options.description: The reasoning part from the message model: its text, whether it streams, its durationMs and whether it is redacted.

options.name: startedAt
options.description: When the reasoning started. Pass it when the view can be rebuilt while the part streams, so the timer does not restart. The moment the view appears when nil.

options.name: startsExpanded
options.description: Whether finished reasoning starts open. Streaming reasoning always starts open.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, including the duration format.

options.name: onExpandedChange
options.description: Called when the disclosure opens or closes, by the person or automatically when the reasoning finishes or starts again.

states.name: streaming
states.description: Open; the header is a MonarchAiThinkingIndicator with the pulsing assistant mark, "Thinking…" and the elapsed time after 3 seconds; the text grows live. With no text yet it is a still row with the same header.

states.name: finished
states.description: Closed; the header reads "Thought for" the part's durationMs, or the time this view measured, or "Thought" when neither is known.

states.name: touched
states.description: If the person opens or closes it while it streams, it stays as they left it when the reasoning finishes.

states.name: restarted
states.description: When a finished part streams again (a regeneration), it opens and measures again.

states.name: redacted
states.description: A still row with the assistant mark and "Reasoning hidden"; no disclosure and no text.

appearance: The header uses the Monarch disclosure group style; the thinking mark and the still-row glyph take the AI strong role; the reasoning text takes the muted text role beside a thin rule in the AI border role. All colours are theme roles, so dark and high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web wraps a details element and renders the text with AiStreamingText; iOS uses the standard DisclosureGroup and plain selectable Text, because iOS has no streaming text component yet. The web chevron leads; the Monarch disclosure style puts it at the trailing edge. The web's onOpenChange is onExpandedChange; its locale prop is the SwiftUI locale environment. The web prefixes the summary with hidden text; iOS puts the prefix in the header's accessibility label.
accessibility: The header is the disclosure button of MonarchDisclosureGroupStyle, labelled "Assistant reasoning: Thought for 12s" (or "Thinking…") with an Expanded or Collapsed value.
Redacted or empty reasoning is one element with the same label and no button.
The live timer is not read on every tick and the reasoning is not announced; VoiceOver reads the current header when it reaches it.
With Reduce Motion the thinking mark stops pulsing (the timer still ticks once a second) and the content opens without animation.
The header and the still row are at least 44 points high; text scales with Dynamic Type.
edgeCases: A part that streams with no text yet shows the live header without a disclosure, then becomes a disclosure when text arrives.
A durationMs on the part wins over the time this view measured.
Durations round to whole seconds and are at least 1 second.
Long reasoning wraps; the disclosure has no height limit.
